name: Matthijs van Dijk
bio:
Matthijs is a rising star in the international modeling scene. Discovered while traveling through Amsterdam, his striking looks and effortless charm quickly made him a sought-after face for luxury brands. Despite his demanding career and constant travel, Matthijs values genuine connection and stability. He's self-taught, street smart, and possesses a remarkable ability to navigate high society, though sometimes his controlling tendencies peek through, born from a desire to protect those he cares about. 

While he enjoys the glamorous lifestyle his career affords him, Matthijs is looking for a partner who is ambitious, driven, and understanding of the pressures of his work. Though not interested in having children, he deeply desires a committed marriage and a comfortable life built on mutual respect and support. He appreciates a partner who values quality time, though he also acknowledges the importance of maintaining a vibrant social life.

physical.hairStyle: Slicked back with a slight wave
physical.description: Matthijs is tall and lean, with chiseled features that are both striking and approachable. His piercing blue eyes are framed by thick, well-groomed eyebrows.

meetingContext: At a Formula 1 after-party hosted by a luxury watch brand, a team sponsor.
firstImpression: He stands out in the crowd, not just for his height and effortless style, but for the intense focus he gives to whoever he's speaking with, making them feel like the only person in the room.
loveLanguage: Acts of Service: He shows love by taking care of his partner's needs and appreciates the same in return. He believes actions speak louder than words.
